QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_TEST_CONSTANT_FLOW_VALGRIND` and `MBEDTLS_TEST_CONSTANT_FLOW_MEMSAN` make tests mark secrets as uninitialised. Any branch or address computed from a secret then shows up as an uninitialised-value error
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer names the valgrind/MSan constant-flow test facility but never says it is off by default or that it is explicitly not part of the library API.
